titleEn: Competitive Advantage: Creating and Sustaining Superior Performance
author: Michael E. Porter
introFa: کتاب «Competitive Advantage: Creating and Sustaining Superior Performance» نوشته Michael E. Porter یکی از منابع ارزشمند و معتبر برای یادگیری زبان انگلیسی در سطح C1 است. این اثر با ساختاری منسجم و غنی، شما را در تسلط بر واژگان و درک مطلب یاری می‌کند.
readingTipsFa: پیش از مطالعه هر بخش از کتاب «Competitive Advantage: Creating and Sustaining Superior Performance»، نگاهی سریع به تیترها و ساختار آن بیندازید.
واژگان و اصطلاحات جدید را در زمینه و بافت جمله یادداشت کنید تا در حافظه بلندمدت تثبیت شوند.
پس از پایان هر فصل، نکات کلیدی و آموخته‌های خود را مرور کرده و به زبان خود خلاصه کنید.

In view of this increasingly competitive situation worldwide, NutraSweet management built a consensus that an independent intelligence function was necessary. The main prerequisite to establishing an intelligence function in any company is the building of just such a con- sensus. The business intelligence (BI) system must be seen by management first as a worthy endeavor. Prose, oral presentation, phone, electronic mail, and face-to-face communications are all effective within their spheres. However, the frequent fact-to-face meeting is a critical method of communication that should not be overlooked. The subject of intelligence is not a cut-and- dried affair; much of it cannot be modeled or quantified. Business decisions are sometimes very subjective and the need for psychological interpretation is critical. Face-to- face meeting is the best way to accomplish this. Finally, the qualities which make a good BI profes- sional are an ability to put oneself in the shoes of manage- ment, an ability to anticipate the needs of one’s customers, a balance between prudence and darin a generalist out- look, good communication skills, an f a genuine enjoy- ment of one’s job.
